description: This Java class 'PointNode' represents a point within a printed circuit board (PCB) context, extending 'PcbNode'. It manages point coordinates (x,y), optional angle, and includes methods for translation, connection checks, and string representation.

classes.name: PointNode
classes.description: Represents a point in 2D space with optional angle, used for PCB layout or design purposes.

methods.name: PointNode(String nodeName, int i, List<Object> children)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a PointNode from a list of children, parsing coordinates and angle if present.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a PointNode with x and y coordinates, defaulting angle to zero.

methods.name: PointNode(double x, double y, double angle)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a PointNode with specified x, y, and angle.

methods.name: isConnected(PointNode at, SizeNode size)
methods.description: Checks if this point is within the specified size bounds of another point.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PointNode.

methods.name: translate(PointNode at)
methods.description: Translates this point relative to another point, applying rotation based on angle.

methods.name: setLocation(double x, double y)
methods.description: Updates this point's location to the specified x and y coordinates.
